text:
maria: heads up — mid-canary in eu-west is showing a steady p95 jump, started ~5m ago. not huge errors but latency +30% vs baseline. thinking we should consider a partial pin while we triage.
deploy-bot: Canary alert: model-service v2.4.0 -> p95 latency +32% (5m window). Error rate +0.6%. Autoscaling OK. Suggested action: pause traffic shift.
sam: can you confirm which routes are affected? is it all model routes or a subset?
maria: looks concentrated on /generate and /chat endpoints for high-token requests. small endpoints unaffected.
tj: if it's limited to those routes we can do a traffic-split pin for eu-west only. prefer manual pin vs full rollback so we don't disturb other regions.
release-engineering: recommended criteria for partial pin: p95 > 20% for 10m OR error-rate > 2% for 5m OR customer-impacted 5xxs > 0.5%.
maria: we hit criterion 1. meeting threshold now for 8m, likely 10m in ~2m.
ashley: I'll draft a short status for #incidents and DM account-eng for top eu customers. template: "We observed elevated latency for EU users on /generate; we're pinning traffic for eu-west to v2.3.1 while we investigate. ETA 30m." sound ok?
sam: yup. add note about potential transient increased queueing while we shift.
release-engineering: plan — step 1: execute partial pin for eu-west traffic to v2.3.1
step 2: monitor p95 and 5xx for 15m
step 3: if stable, resume rollout with adjusted batch/kvcache settings or keep pinned and cut a rollback release
command: `releases pin --region eu-west --from v2.4.0 --to v2.3.1 --reason "canary p95 regression"`
tj: I can run the pin now and stay with monitoring. will run from my laptop in 2m and post logs.
oncall-bot: scheduled maintenance window not impacted. Change window: rolling, no full downtime.
maria: assign roles — tj will execute pin and watchmetrics, sam will take lead on investigation (KV cache & kernel selection), ashley will handle external comms, release-engineering will prepare rollback branch if needed.
ashley: drafting incident post now, will post after pin confirmation. adding checklist: customer notif, changelog note, update release notes, update ticket in JIRA.
release-engineering: FYI — if pin fails, fallback is automatic rollback to v2.3.1 across all regions after ops sign-off. prefer manual handling first.
deploy-bot: Action executed: traffic-split pause requested by tj. awaiting confirmation of pin.
tj: running: `releases pin --region eu-west --to v2.3.1` ...
tj: done — API returned success. new traffic split: 100% eu-west -> v2.3.1. Logs: `pin_id=pin-2026-03-20-01`
maria: monitoring p95/5xx now. initial drop in p95 visible. will report at +5m and +15m.
sam: starting KV cache trace and kernel perf logs. sharing pointer: https://internal-logs/reports/trace-123
ashley: posting to #incidents now: "EU users: partial pin executed to v2.3.1 to mitigate elevated p95 on /generate. Monitoring. Will update in 15m."
release-engineering: nice. after 15m if stable, we should capture a short postmortem focused on model batch sizes and kvcache warmup and add a regression test to the canary harness.
maria: agreed. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Reminder: if SLA customers affected, escalate to oncall pager after 30m of degraded latency.
ashley: putting note for account-eng to expect a short email now. will share draft in #eng-releases-private channel for review.
tj: will keep terminal open and watch dashboards. ping me if you want me to revert traffic.
sam: logs look promising, initial hypothesis is a quantization kernel path on v2.4.0 for long sequences. investigating.
maria: OK — we'll keep the partial pin for the change window and reconvene at +15. If anything changes, post in this thread."
